note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; soldier, worker and alate are all described; the measurement tables (Table 4, Table 5), figure numbers, type specimen records and distribution records are not translated; measurements in the text are reproduced as given.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier slightly smaller than K. thakuri; the shape of the postmentum and the degree of constriction at its waist distinguish this species from its congeners; soldier left mandible strongly twisted, right mandible blade-like.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellowish brown to light yellowish brown; antennae pale yellow to light brown; labrum pale yellow, transparent near the anterior margin; left mandible blackish brown, right mandible brown to reddish brown; legs and body pale yellow. Cephalic setae very sparse (lost after long storage), body setae more numerous. Body length 4.7–4.8 mm. Head capsule subquadrate; in lateral view the frons inclined about 45 degrees; the median arm of the Y-suture present, not reaching the middle of the head. Fontanelle transverse, situated anteriorly; fontanelle gland large, extending beyond the middle of the head. Antennae 14-segmented; segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2; segment 4 slightly shorter than segment 3 and the shortest; segments 5–8 gradually longer; the remaining ones nearly equal. Labrum ligulate; anterior margin nearly straight, without anterolateral points or horn-like processes. Mandibles strongly asymmetrical, shorter than the head. Left mandible strongly twisted; apex rounded, without a beak-like point, but with a slight concave trace at the apex. Right mandible blade-like; the apical part of the outer margin weakly incurved; inner margin undulate; apex straight, bluntly pointed. Postmentum subquadrate; anterior part weakly convex; waist rather broad (postmental constriction index 0.842–0.875). Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin without a notch.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow; antennae, postclypeus, labrum and thorax paler than the head capsule; abdomen transparent, the intestinal contents visible. Cephalic setae sparse, body setae more numerous (setae possibly lost). Body length 3.0–3.5 mm. Head capsule subcircular, widest at the mandibular bases (length to the tip of the labrum 1.30–1.35 mm, length to mandibular base 0.80–0.85 mm, maximum width 1.08 mm); the median suture partly visible. Fontanelle plate oval, its mark indistinct. Antennae 14-segmented. Postclypeus inflated; about half as long as wide (length 0.23–0.25 mm, width 0.50–0.55 mm); anterior margin straight. Mandibles as in the alate. Pronotum as in the soldier.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown; postclypeus slightly paler than the head capsule; fontanelle plate darker; labrum pale yellowish brown; antennae brownish, paler than the postclypeus; pronotum paler than the head capsule, slightly darker posteriorly; abdominal tergites brown, paler than the head capsule, sternites light brown and the middle of the anterior sternites paler; legs light brown; wings light brown, transparent. Head densely covered with fine short setae and with a few long setae; pronotum and body similarly densely hairy; the anterior and posterior margins of the wings each with a row of setae, the wing membrane bare. Body length without wings about 5.0–5.5 mm (wings broken in the specimens). Head capsule subcircular, concave around the fontanelle; Y-suture indistinct, a trace of the median arm sometimes visible near the posterior margin. Fontanelle plate large, oval, slightly larger than the ocellus, slightly darker than the head capsule. Compound eyes subcircular (maximum diameter 0.30–0.33 mm, minimum diameter 0.30 mm), close to the lateral margin of the head. Ocellus oval and broad, separated from the compound eye and the antenna by about its short diameter. Antennae 15-segmented; segment 2 slightly smaller than segment 1; segment 3 nearly as long as segment 5 and short; segment 4 longer than segment 3 or 5; segments 6–10 gradually longer; the remaining ones nearly equal. Postclypeus inflated, hairy; about half as long as wide; the median line distinct, dividing it into two halves; anterior margin straight. Mandibles as in the genus. Pronotum semicircular, the anterior part slightly raised; anterior margin incurved with a faint median notch; sides rounded; posterior margin convex with a distinct median notch; wings and legs as in the genus.
